title: Evaluating CLIP: Towards Characterization of Broader Capabilities and Downstream Implications
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith/religion. The paper's bias analysis focused on demographic categories such as race, age, and gender.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the analysis. The study investigated biases in the CLIP model concerning race, gender, and age.
